spans.s: dham, syllable used in learning to write, see s.v. si.
dhamana, nt., a high number: Mvy 〔7917〕 (cited from Gv) = Tib. ḥdzin yas; Gv 〔106.17〕; 〔133.26〕. Cf. next. Mironov has the same reading in Mvy.
dhamara, m., a high number: Mvy 〔7788〕 = Tib. ḥdzin yas. Cf. prec. Mironov has the same reading, but it seems likely (in view of Gvʼs confirmation of ˚nam) that ˚ra is an error for ˚na.
